edges: Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne leaves the Skylark by parachute near Earth.
The Skylark lands on Crane's Field.
The Skylark returns to Earth laden with jewels, platinum, radium, and Element X.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne leaves the Skylark by parachute near Earth.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Martin Crane's marriage to Margaret 'Peg' Spencer is solemnized by the Kondalian monarchy.
Dick Seaton rescues Margaret 'Peg' Spencer along with Dorothy Vaneman.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne kidnaps Dorothy Vaneman to exchange for Element X.
Dick Seaton befriends Prince Dunark during their journey.
They obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
Prince Dunark and Princess Sitar assist Dick Seaton and his friends in destroying Mardonale.
